Q: A team wants to use generative AI on customer data.
   What do you check first?

A: I'd confirm the data's classification --
   if it's restricted, it likely can't go into
   the tool without a reviewed vendor agreement.

   I'd loop in security and legal on the vendor's
   data-handling terms, and require human review
   of outputs before anything reaches a customer.
caption: Confident on the governance angle, honest about who else is involved
